_note: Shared parts of the condition detail template (Figma 41:2373 / 67:3070). Visible text exactly as in Figma. pending.* and generated.* are NOT in Figma (PLACEHOLDER). Arabic overviewHeading (shared.ar.json) = the documents' 'نبذة عن البرنامج' line; a page may override it (overviewHeading in its own file).

pending.note: Content pending: this page is generated from the condition card until the full text is supplied.
pending.banner: Banner photo pending for this condition: the shared placeholder is shown until the page's own photo is supplied.

generated._note: Pages without a content file (src/data/content/conditions/<slug>.en.json): hero title = card title, overview = card summary. Hero image + button are PLACEHOLDERS (Accidents Rehabilitation image), flagged. The same banner is the FALLBACK of a page whose own key (hero.banner.image = conditions/<slug>, bug 042) has no file in src/assets yet (R042) - shown with pending.banner on staging.
